breakdown.description: Preamble states two incompatible interpretations of Nx and dx (interval-based vs point-based).
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly resolved the conflicting instructions regarding the grid definition. The incomplete prompt provided a general preamble with two incompatible definitions for Nx and dx. The agent correctly ignored the contradictory instruction ("In this task, interpret Nx as the number of grid points including both endpoints... and set dx=(b-a)/(Nx-1)") and instead adopted the correct definition for a periodic domain as specified later in the prompt's numerical method section ("dx=1/Nx"). This aligns perfectly with the ground truth, which removes the contradictory text entirely.
